title: पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 45 · Bride-price and the husbandless bride

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks what is to be done if the maiden for whom the bride-price was paid has no husband, and about the sale of daughters. Bhishma says that the selling of one's offspring is not right dharma, and that those who take payment for a daughter are wicked and of demonic birth.
summary.kn: ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಡೆದ ಕನ್ಯೆಗೆ ಪತಿಯಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಕನ್ಯಾ ಮಾರಾಟದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸ್ವಂತ ಸಂತಾನ ಮಾರುವುದು ಧರ್ಮವಲ್ಲ, ಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಧನ ಪಡೆಯುವವರು ದುಷ್ಟರು, ಆಸುರ ಜನ್ಮದವರು ಎಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि जिस कन्या के लिए शुल्क दिया गया उसका कोई पति न हो तो क्या हो, और कन्याओं की बिक्री पर। भीष्म कहते हैं कि अपनी सन्तान बेचना उचित धर्म नहीं, और पुत्री के लिए मूल्य लेने वाले दुष्ट और आसुरी जन्म के हैं।
summary.te: వధూ శుల్కం ఇచ్చిన కన్యకు భర్త లేకపోతే ఏం చేయాలి, కన్యలను అమ్మడం గురించి యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. సంతానాన్ని అమ్మడం సరైన ధర్మం కాదని, కూతురికి వెల తీసుకునేవారు దుష్టులు, ఆసుర జన్మలని భీష్ముడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: மணக்கொடை பெற்ற கன்னிக்குக் கணவன் இல்லையெனில் என்ன செய்வது, பெண்களை விற்பது பற்றி யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, தம் குழந்தைகளை விற்பது சரியான தர்மமல்ல, மகளுக்கு விலை பெறுவோர் தீயோர், அசுரப் பிறவியினர் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ശുൽക്കം നൽകിയ കന്യകയ്ക്ക് ഭർത്താവില്ലെങ്കിൽ എന്തു ചെയ്യണമെന്നും, പുത്രിമാരെ വിൽക്കുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. സന്താനങ്ങളെ വിൽക്കുന്നത് ശരിയായ ധർമ്മമല്ലെന്നും, പുത്രിക്കായി പണം വാങ്ങുന്നവർ ദുഷ്ടരും അസുരജന്മമുള്ളവരുമാണെന്നും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.45; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कन्यायाः प्राप्तशुल्कायाः पतिश्चेन्नास्ति कश्चन ।
तत्र का प्रतिपत्तिः स्यात्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: If a girl for whom the bride-price has been paid has no husband at all, what course is open to her? Tell me that, grandfather.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text: यापुत्रकस्याप्यरिक्थस्य प्रतिपत्सा तदा भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Even for a man who has no son and no property, there would then be a way of dealing with it, as follows.

verses.text:
अथ चेत्साहरेच्छुल्कं क्रीता शुल्कप्रदस्य सा ।
तस्यार्थेऽपत्यमीहेत येन न्यायेन शक्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: If she should bring back the bride-price, she is regarded as bought by the one who paid it. For his sake she should seek offspring by whatever lawful method she can.

verses.text: न तस्या मन्त्रवत्कार्यं कश्चित्कुर्वीत किंचन ॥

meaning.en: No one should perform anything for her with mantras.

verses.text:
स्वयं वृतेति सावित्री पित्रा वै प्रत्यपद्यत ।
तत्तस्यान्ये प्रशंसन्ति धर्मज्ञा नेतरे जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Savitri, who chose for herself, was accepted by her father. Others who know dharma approve that for her, though not all people do.

verses.text:
एतत्तु नापरे चक्रुर्न परे जातु साधवः ।
साधूनां पुनराचारो गरीयो धर्मलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: But other good people never did this, nor did the good before them. The conduct of the good is still the weightier mark of dharma.

verses.text:
अस्मिन्नेव प्रकरणे सुक्रतुर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
नप्ता विदेहराजस्य जनकस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: On this very subject Sukratu, grandson of the great-souled Janaka, king of Videha, spoke these words:

verses.text:
असदाचरिते मार्गे कथं स्यादनुकीर्तनम् ।
अनुप्रश्नः संशयो वा सतामेतदुपालभेत् ॥

meaning.en: How could one praise a course that rests on improper conduct? Questioning or doubt about it would be a reproach to the good.

verses.text:
असदेव हि धर्मस्य प्रमादो धर्म आसुरः ।
नानुशुश्रुम जात्वेतामिमां पूर्वेषु जन्मसु ॥

meaning.en: A lapse in dharma is itself improper, and the asura form is of that sort. We have never heard of this in earlier births.

verses.text:
भार्यापत्योर्हि संबन्धः स्त्रीपुंसोस्तुल्य एव सः ।
रतिः साधारणो धर्म इति चाह स पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: The bond between wife and husband is equal for woman and man; pleasure is a duty shared by both, so that king said.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
अथ केन प्रमाणेन पुंसामादीयते धनम् ।
पुत्रवद्धि पितुस्तस्य कन्या भवितुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: By what proof, then, is a man's wealth taken over? A daughter ought to be like a son to her father.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
यथैवात्मा तथा पुत्रः पुत्रेण दुहिता समा ।
तस्यामात्मनि तिष्ठन्त्यां कथमन्यो धनं हरेत् ॥

meaning.en: As the self, so is a son, and a daughter is equal to a son. While she remains as himself, how can another take the property?

verses.text:
मातुश्च यौतकं यत्स्यात्कुमारीभाग एव सः ।
दौहित्र एव वा रिक्थमपुत्रस्य पितुर्हरेत् ॥

meaning.en: What is the mother's dowry belongs to the unmarried girl's share; or the daughter's son alone may take the estate of a man without a son.

verses.text:
ददाति हि स पिण्डं वै पितुर्मातामहस्य च ।
पुत्रदौहित्रयोर्नेह विशेषो धर्मतः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: For he offers the funeral cake both to his father and to his mother's father. In dharma no difference between a son and a daughter's son is recorded here.

verses.text:
अन्यत्र जातया सा हि प्रजया पुत्र ईहते ।
दुहितान्यत्र जातेन पुत्रेणापि विशिष्यते ॥

meaning.en: A son strives through offspring born elsewhere than in her father's house, while a daughter is even more distinguished by a son born elsewhere.

verses.text:
दौहित्रकेण धर्मेण नात्र पश्यामि कारणम् ।
विक्रीतासु च ये पुत्रा भवन्ति पितुरेव ते ॥

meaning.en: I see no reason against the daughter's-son rule here. The sons born of women who have been sold belong to the father alone.

verses.text:
असूयवस्त्वधर्मिष्ठाः परस्वादायिनः शठाः ।
आसुरादधिसंभूता धर्माद्विषमवृत्तयः ॥

meaning.en: They are fault-finding, unrighteous, takers of others' property, deceitful, born of the asura form, and uneven in conduct by dharma.

verses.text:
अत्र गाथा यमोद्गीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः ।
धर्मज्ञा धर्मशास्त्रेषु निबद्धा धर्मसेतुषु ॥

meaning.en: On this subject those versed in the old lore recite verses sung by Yama, which the knowers of dharma set down in the treatises as bridges of dharma:

verses.text:
यो मनुष्यः स्वकं पुत्रं विक्रीय धनमिच्छति ।
कन्यां वा जीवितार्थाय यः शुल्केन प्रयच्छति ॥

meaning.en: The man who sells his own son and wants wealth for it, or who gives a girl for a bride-price to live by,

verses.text:
सप्तावरे महाघोरे निरये कालसाह्वये ।
स्वेदं मूत्रं पुरीषं च तस्मिन्प्रेत उपाश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: falls into a dreadful hell named Kala that lasts seven lower ages; there, after death, he must feed on sweat, urine and excrement.

verses.text:
आर्षे गोमिथुनं शुल्कं केचिदाहुर्मृषैव तत् ।
अल्पं वा बहु वा राजन्विक्रयस्तावदेव सः ॥

meaning.en: Some say that a pair of cattle in the arsha form is a bride-price; that is simply false. Great or small, king, it is only a sale.

verses.text:
यद्यप्याचरितः कैश्चिन्नैष धर्मः कथंचन ।
अन्येषामपि दृश्यन्ते लोभतः संप्रवृत्तयः ॥

meaning.en: Even if some people have practiced it, it is not dharma at all. In others too we see conduct arising from greed.

verses.text:
वश्यां कुमारीं विहितां ये च तामुपभुञ्जते ।
एते पापस्य कर्तारस्तमस्यन्धेऽथ शेरते ॥

meaning.en: Those who enjoy an unmarried girl who is under their control and given, these evildoers lie in blind darkness.

verses.text:
अन्योऽप्यथ न विक्रेयो मनुष्यः किं पुनः प्रजाः ।
अधर्ममूलैर्हि धनैर्न तैरर्थोऽस्ति कश्चन ॥

meaning.en: Even any other human being is not to be sold, let alone one's children. No gain comes from wealth whose root is unrighteousness.
